name: AllTopStartups

sources.title: Submit Your Startup page — directory and premium options

requirements: Free listings are explicitly SUSPENDED: 'Getting featured is free but we have currently suspended free listings. We are reviewing backlog of hundreds of startup submissions.'
Business and technology related products/services only — 'We don't accept all types of startups'
Option 1 — Directory Listing: listing within 48 hours, verified green badge, 1 week homepage feature, DA-73 backlink
Option 2 — Premium: adds a written review on the blog, 1-month homepage feature, promotion to ~70K Twitter followers
preparation: Payment method — Stripe or PayPal (Visa/Mastercard/Amex accepted)
For the premium tier: material for a full written review (story, differentiators, screenshots)
workflow: Choose Option 1 (directory listing) or Option 2 (premium listing + review)
Submit the form and pay via Stripe/PayPal
Listing/review publishes within 48 hours per the page's promise
Verify the green-badge listing appears in /directory and on the homepage for the stated window
watchFor: Free route is closed with an open-ended backlog — do not submit expecting a free listing
Prices are not printed on the page — shown during/after the form
Page contains typos ('It takes time, money, and effort to punish and maintain listings') — small-operator site; keep records of payment and promised deliverables
A separate 'Submit Your Startup Story' (/success-story/) route exists for founder stories
countsAsLive: A verified green-badge entry visible in the AllTopStartups /directory (and a review post if the premium option was purchased)
unknowns: Current prices for Option 1 and Option 2
Whether the backlink is dofollow (claimed 'DA 73 backlink' without rel detail)
